This executable matrix example replaces a historical example that used an
outdated dataset adapter. It estimates descriptive task-modulated covariance;
for a conventional seed-based gPPI workflow see the Conventional PPI vignette.

```{r}
library(multiPPI)
set.seed(42)
n <- 100L
runs <- rep(1:2, each = 50)
Y <- matrix(rnorm(n * 4), nrow = n)
X <- cbind(intercept = 1, task = rep(c(0, 1), length.out = n))
fit <- mppi_fit(Y, X, psych_idx = 2, runs = runs, scale = "cov")
mppi_get_M(fit, 1)
```

The output is a covariance slope, not a conventional PPI coefficient or a
causal estimate. Unsupported covariance permutation procedures fail closed.
